what: How well Omnilingual ASR (Andy's own ears) hears Meta's two open voices saying Andy's own lines, on this computer, 2026-10-30. A stand-in for clarity, not a listening test; the founder then picked the voice by ear on the robot's speaker.
lines: There they are! I see your glasses, to my right.
Your keys are on the desk, behind the keyboard.
Found it! I see your mug, a little to my left, about five feet away.
Hmm, I couldn't find your remote from here. Where did you last have it?
Your reminder is set for three fifteen.
Keep an eye on my keys.

seamless_m4t_v2.model: facebook/seamless-m4t-v2-large (text-to-speech half, speaker 0, fp32 on the processor)

chosen: SeamlessM4T v2, speaker 51, slowed 8%, highpass 120 Hz, +6 dB at 3 kHz, peak-normalised: option 2 of 5 played on the robot's speaker, picked by the founder
